identity: Classical quadratic principal tricomplex Mandelbrot slice T(i1,i2,j1), j1=i1*i2
membership: Both complex components belong to the ordinary quadratic Mandelbrot set

distinct_from.tetrabrot_3d: Mousebrot mixes x with +/-y in the imaginary components and +/-z in the real components; Tetrabrot uses x+(y+/-z)i
distinct_from.arrowheadbrot_3d: Mousebrot has z-dependent opposite real parts and x+/-y imaginary parts; Arrowheadbrot uses (x+/-z)+yi
distinct_from.turtlebrot_3d: The source characterizes Turtlebrot as an intersection of reflected Mousebrot-related slices, not Mousebrot itself
distinct_from.power_variants: Classical identity is fixed at quadratic p=2

sources.title: Relationship between the Mandelbrot Algorithm and the Platonic Solids
sources.claim: Names Mousebrot as Figure 3(c), whose caption identifies T(i1,i2,j1)

sources.title: Characterization of the Principal 3D Slices Related to the Multicomplex Mandelbrot Set
sources.claim: Provides the general idempotent decomposition, componentwise membership theorem, and Euclidean norm
